d.title: Lupin the IIIrd: Mine Fujiko no Uso
d.en: Lupin the Third: Fujiko Mine's Lie
d.jp: LUPIN THE IIIRD 峰不二子の嘘
d.synopsis: Fujiko Mine is on the run with Gene, a boy who knows the location of a stash of $500 million dollars that his deceased father embezzled from the company Godfrey Mining. The boy is targeted by Bincam, an assassin hired by Godfrey Mining with a mysterious ability that allows him to bend a person’s will.
